business.title: National Healthcare Properties Announces Preferred Stock Dividends
business.description: NEW YORK, June 22, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- National Healthcare Properties, Inc. (Nasdaq: NHP / NHPAP / NHPBP) ('NHP” or the 'Company”) announced today that it declared quarterly dividends on its outstanding preferred stock. Specifically, NHP declared a dividend of $0.4609375 per share on its 7.375% Series A Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock payable on July 15, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on July 2, 2026. In addition, NHP declared a dividend of $0.4453125 per share on its 7.125% Series B Cumulative Redeemable Perpetual Preferred Stock payable on July 15, 2026, to holders of record at the close of business on July 2, 2026.
